title: 🏠️ Repo workspace wire shapes
description: 🏠️ The three vector files the workspace cases read, and the projections every implementation of root discovery, layout, config, glob matching and ignore matching must produce.

VerdictProjection.description: 🎯️ One `<vector name>=<true|false>` entry per vector, in vector order.

roots.description: 🧭️ `<tree name>=<discovered root, relative to the tree root, forward slashes>`.

layout.description: 🧱️ `<layout key>=<path relative to the repo root, forward slashes>`.
